body: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.
summaryZh: 前沿大模型可以生成引导搜索的启发式函数，但这些启发式通常无法保证可采纳性（admissibility），从而可能导致次优规划。本文介绍了LeanPlan，这是首个利用大模型生成具备机器可检验可采纳性证明的启发式函数的规划系统。通过在Lean 4中结合智能体反馈循环与形式化验证，LeanPlan在多个规划基准测试中展现出卓越的状态空间搜索效率和求解能力。

glossary.explanationZh: 启发式函数，用于估计从当前状态到目标状态代价的函数，在图搜索和规划中指导搜索方向
可采纳性，指启发式函数估计的代价永不高于实际剩余最优代价的性质，能保证搜索找到最优解
一种交互式定理证明器和现代泛函编程语言，用于形式化数学证明和机器检验
